correctness.rationale: Algorithm 1 gives B_t v_t=B_{t−1}v_{t−1}+b_t g_t², with B_0=0 and b_t=t^(−γ). Subtracting the all-baseline recurrence leaves zero for t<τ and exactly (H²−G²)τ^(−γ) in B_t(v_t−G²) for t≥τ. Integral comparison gives B_t∼t^(1−γ)/(1−γ) for 0≤γ<1 (at γ=0 it is exactly t), B_t∼log t for γ=1, and B_t→ζ(γ) for γ>1. These prove the constants, the positive permanent imprint, and the special γ=0.1 tail. Since G>0, taking the inverse-square-root ratio gives exactly the claimed rescaling, with limit 1 or strictly below 1 as stated. The calculation is for fixed τ and the prescribed one-coordinate input; it does not prove a trajectory statement, a momentum statement, or convergence of the full optimizer. The frozen verify.py was inspected but not executed; numerical guards are not required for these exact identities.
